subject: Scheduling: demo coverage during US/EU DST mismatch (propose slots)

Date: Sat, 07 Mar 2026 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Demo next week — timezone check

Hi Markus,

Quick question about our scheduled demo: we currently have the session set for Friday, 12 March at 09:00 CET to accommodate our London and Madrid team. Some of our US folks flagged that they saw the invite as 04:00 ET — that timing will be rough for them.

I know the US moves clocks forward the week of Mar 8 and the EU moves later in the month — I just want to make sure we handle the one-week mismatch so everyone sees the correct local time. Can you propose a couple of alternate windows that work for Redwood and your SEs (we also have a small APAC participant who can join late afternoon CET / morning APAC)?

Thanks,
Priya Varma
Senior PM, LumenBank

Hi Priya — thanks for the heads up. Good catch on the DST gap. The US spring-forward on Sun Mar 8 will create that odd week where an invite created in CET can look off in ET.

To avoid confusion I propose three concrete options (all times shown as CET / (ET) / (AEST) as reference):

- Option A — 12 Mar, 14:00 CET (09:00 ET / 23:00 AEST) — heavy for APAC, maybe not ideal.
- Option B — 12 Mar, 16:00 CET (11:00 ET / 01:00 next day AEST) — better for US, late for APAC.
- Option C — 15 Mar, 08:30 CET (03:30 ET / 18:30 AEST) — early for US but sometimes workable for small US coverage.

Vanessa and Mina — can you confirm SE coverage for Options A/B/C? If none are great we can split the demo into two shorter sessions (EU/US overlap + separate APAC follow-up).

I’m attaching a short demo runbook and a provisional .ics with the three proposed slots to simplify invites. Once Lumen picks, I’ll send separate invites labelled clearly with local times and a note about the DST difference.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Markus.Klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0173

Attachments: redwood_demo_runbook_v1.pdf (15 KB, stub), proposed_slots.ics (calendar stub)

All — quick availability check from SE side: I can cover Option B (Mar 12, 16:00 CET) and Option A on a best-effort. Mina can shift later to cover APAC overlap on Option A but prefers B. Grace — are you able to join the EU-side handoff for B?

If Lumen needs true global overlap, splitting into a 45-min EU/US-focused demo (Option B) and a recorded/APAC office-hours follow-up is our recommended path — less painful for everyone's calendars and keeps latency/cost Q&A live for the primary stakeholders.

Also: when we send invites, we should choose "Show time zone" in the Google invite and include this short note in the description: "Note: US clocks move forward Sun 8 Mar; if your calendar shows a different local time, please refer to the session times listed below or contact us — we will send country-localized invites."

-Vanessa
